digest.episode_summary: Level 1 completed in 20 charged actions. The movable two-color 5×5 avatar navigates five-cell lanes. Entry into the framed goal was blocked while the enlarged bottom-left state glyph differed from the target; stepping onto a 0/1 floor marker changed that glyph, and entry succeeded once the glyphs matched.

memories.claim: Across unchanged adapter semantics, action 0 moves up, 1 moves down, 2 moves left, and 3 moves right, normally by five grid cells.
A cardinal move into an impassable boundary can consume an action while leaving the visible state unchanged.
guard_features: avatar adjacent to wall or gated target
source and successor observations visually identical

memories.claim: The framed target is gated by equality between its small glyph and the enlarged bottom-left state glyph; proximity alone did not suffice, while matched-state entry completed the level.
Stepping onto the small 0/1 floor marker changed the bottom-left glyph while leaving the avatar’s solid two-color appearance unchanged; the edited glyph persisted after moving off the marker.
guard_features: small 0/1 marker embedded in traversable lane

memories.claim: The marker was hidden while occupied and reappeared when the avatar departed, so disappearance under the avatar did not mean consumption.
guard_features: same marker coordinates before overlap and after departure

memories.claim: Disproved hypothesis: moving directly to the target completes the level regardless of the bottom-left glyph.
guard_features: target glyph and bottom-left glyph visibly differ

memories.claim: Disproved hypothesis: the 0/1 marker transforms the visible 5×5 two-color avatar pattern; the observed transformation occurred in the bottom-left glyph instead.
guard_features: avatar colors remain two solid horizontal bands
